stem:
The length of time, $T$ minutes, that a passenger has to wait for a bus at a certain bus stop is modelled by the probability density function given by

$$\text{f}(t) = \begin{cases} \frac{3}{4000}(20t - t^2) & 0 \leqslant t \leqslant 20, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise.} \end{cases}$$

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
It is given that $\text{P}(T < 10 + a) = p$, where $0 < a < 10$.

Find $\text{P}(10 - a < T < 10 + a)$ in terms of $p$.

parts.label: (f)
parts.text: Give one reason why this model may be unrealistic.
